notes: Account: mid-market B2B SaaS building an AI-powered in-app assistant and advanced doc search. Evaluating Hosted API as fast path, with Dedicated for production months 2-3. Key asks: predictable latency under 200 RPS, cost visibility, and easy rollback to smaller model when load spikes. Cost workshop summary: attended by Velora ML Eng (Sanjay Patel), Infra Lead (Marta Ruiz), Product (Talia Gomez). We ran a token-cost exercise comparing hosted baseline vs Dedicated with batching+cache+quantization. Workshop outcomes (informal notes): - Batching: suggested session-level batching pipeline (max batch 64 for chat flows) to hit 2.4x throughput improvement in simulation. Recommendation: use burst lanes for interactive sessions to keep median latency ~120-150ms while batching background rerank jobs. - Caching: prefix/KV caching for repeated context (customer profiles) estimated to reduce generation tokens by 28-35% for their common flows. Proposed short TTL on prefix cache aligned with user session (~30m). - Quantization profiles: recommended try Q4_0 for less-sensitive response generation, Q8 for on-call safety-sensitive endpoints. SE demo: 4-bit quantized baseline reduced GPU memory footprint by ~40% and allowed packing more replicas on Dedicated. - Unit economics: Ran a quick calc in workshop deck: hosted: $0.045 per 1k gen-tokens baseline (example), Dedicated w/ batching+cache+q4: effective unit down to ~$0.012-$0.018 per 1k tokens at 50% cache hit assumption and 2.2x effective batching. Velora engineering excited about potential 3-4x cost savings at scale. - Risk/quality: Product wants an automated eval harness before switching to quantized models; they will supply 300 prompt/eval pairs. - Security: require SSO (SAML) + audit logs + KMS for key wrapping. Data residency not strict but legal prefers NA-only while contracts finalize. Quote from Product lead: "If we can get predictable p95 < 350ms and 2x cost reduction, we can justify moving to Dedicated." POC scope proposed: 4-week POC, target metrics: median latency < 150ms, p95 < 350ms, embedding recall @ 95% baseline, cost reduction >30% vs hosted trials. "Next steps:" SE to provide POC runbook (batching config, cache TTLs, quant profiles), AE to provide committed Dedicated pricing options, security to send SOC2 packet. Blockers: procurement, legal DPA negotiations, final sign-off on SSO details.
